name: Wizard OS Tracker
short_desc: Wizard OS Goals and Bugs on GitHub, with what is ready to test on top.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Two views over a GitHub organisation: Goals and Bugs. Each shows what is ready for you to test (Works / Doesn't work) above what is in progress. Each person signs in with their own GitHub token. New goals and bugs are filed by the agent in chat through narrow MCP tools.
